restaurant_name: Podiatry Thailand - We solve foot, knee, hip, back and neck complaints - consultation by appointment only!
text:
I visited Dr. Rudy’s clinic after seeing his positive reviews, hoping to inquire about his services for what I believe are flat feet. I arrived without an appointment, not realizing one was required. When I politely asked if today was a good day, I was met with repeated questioning about why I hadn’t made an appointment.

It was around 11 AM on a Monday, and it did not appear that he was in the middle of seeing other patients or actively working. I asked several times if today was not a good day, hoping for a clear answer or the chance to schedule for another time. Instead, he kept diverting the conversation back to why I didn’t have an appointment, and told me that as an American I don’t understand how things work in Thailand, and ultimately closed the door on me without offering a future appointment.

I’ve lived in Pattaya for three years, and I recognize Thai hospitality when I see it — what I encountered here was unnecessary and disappointing. I never demanded immediate treatment. I simply came to learn about his services and see if he might have time. A simple, “I’m not available today, but let’s set up an appointment for another time,” would have been appreciated.

I’m sharing this so others know to book ahead and so future visitors can be aware of what to expect.

text:
Absolutely an expert and a savior for feet!!  I had plantars fasciitis and it was extremely painful to walk. I saw a doctor in a hospital in Bangkok and they gave me a cortisone shot and got me in and out of there in 5 min. It helped initially but it was not a long-term fix (and in retrospect not a good short-term fix either).

Later I saw Rudolf and he didn’t rush at all but took the time to give me a proper exam (only 1000 baht). A few days later he had made for me custom insoles (6000 baht) and custom made sandals (8000 baht).

Within 2 weeks my plantars fasciitis is now nearly fully healed!!

I plan to order another set of insoles from him as soon as I return to Pattaya. Very grateful for finding this true expert and master of his craft!
